description: Etherscan public address-label cloud: entity labels (e.g. Binance, 0x Protocol) with counts of tagged accounts, transactions and tokens, from the label page's embedded data. Filter by name or take the top labels by total. Does not list individual deposit wallets and does not separate CEX deposit tags from other labels. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

name.description: Optional case-insensitive part of a label name, e.g. binance

name: crypto_etherscan_label_cloud
title: Crypto Etherscan Label Cloud
